weapon_skin_lifetime_system.mechanism: Accumulate lifetime progress by collecting time-limited versions

rank_protection_cards.type: Time-limited and automatically used during ranked matches
rank_protection_cards.restrictions: Strict restrictions on rank, season, and availability
rank_protection_cards.conversion: Former rank protection cards converted to equal amounts of new cards

team_rank_restrictions.rule: Rank gap restrictions applied to incomplete teams to prevent excessive tier disparity in matchmaking
team_rank_restrictions.exemption: Full squad teams exempt from rank restrictions

teamwork_appreciation.impact: Contributes to final score and displayed on match results page

training_grounds.social_zone: Separated into an independent Social Island accessible from bottom of mode selection page

qol_and_system_optimizations.armor_attachments: Automatically substituted with higher-tier versions upon pickup
qol_and_system_optimizations.knockdown_post_revive: Player can choose to stand or crouch immediately after being helped up
qol_and_system_optimizations.br_give_up_option: Knocked down players can manually choose to give up their life
qol_and_system_optimizations.death_analysis: Displays elimination reason and enemy damage breakdown upon knockdown
qol_and_system_optimizations.audio_balancing: Added slider to adjust voice message vs sound effect ratio without affecting master volume
qol_and_system_optimizations.download_center: Obsolete legacy assets excluded from auto-download pool
qol_and_system_optimizations.report_system: Immediate feedback pop-up upon successful player report
